entries.label: Smart Watches
entries.quote: The designers of the Pebble watch realized that a mobile phone is more useful if you don't have to take it out of your pocket.
entries.note: Organizations in article: Pebble, Sony, Samsung, Apple, Google.

entries.label: Ultra-Efficient Solar Power
entries.quote: Doubling the efficiency of solar devices would completely change the economics of renewable energy. Here is a design that just might make it possible.

entries.label: Memory Implants
entries.quote: A maverick neuroscientist believes he has deciphered the code by which the brain forms long-term memories.
entries.note: Organizations in article: University of Southern California. Body text: animal prostheses planned within two years.

entries.label: Prenatal DNA Sequencing
entries.quote: Reading the DNA of fetuses is the next frontier of the genome revolution. Do you really want to know the genetic destiny of your unborn child?

entries.label: Deep Learning
entries.quote: With massive amounts of computational power, machines can now recognize objects and translate speech in real time. Artificial intelligence is finally getting smart.
entries.note: Organizations in article: Google, Microsoft, IBM.

entries.label: Additive Manufacturing
entries.quote: GE, the world's largest manufacturer, is on the verge of using 3-D printing to make jet parts.
entries.note: Organizations in article: GE Aviation, CFM International. Body text: nozzles "due to go into planes in late 2015 or early 2016".

entries.label: Big Data from Cheap Phones
entries.quote: Collecting and analyzing information from simple cell phones can provide surprising insights into how people move about and behave—and even help us understand the spread of diseases.
entries.note: Organizations in article: Harvard School of Public Health, Orange, MIT, Jana.

entries.label: Temporary Social Media
entries.quote: Messages that quickly self-destruct could enhance the privacy of online communication and make people feel freer to be spontaneous.

entries.label: Supergrids
entries.quote: A high-power circuit breaker could finally make DC power grids practical.

entries.label: Baxter: The Blue-Collar Robot
entries.quote: Rethink Robotics' new creation is easy to interact with, but the innovations behind the robot show just how hard it is to get along with people.

notes: Ten entries. Web date 2013-04-23 (May/June 2013 issue). The web articles have no Availability and no Key Players field; key_players is null and organizations named in the article are listed in the note. Quote is the article dek. Read through a summarising fetch; medium confidence.
